questions.question: Explain how international migration has affected a named UK city. (4 marks)
questions.correctAnswer: In Bristol, international migration has brought cultural diversity - approximately 16% of the population was born outside the UK, with significant Somali, Polish and South Asian communities (1 mark). Migrants fill labour shortages in sectors like healthcare and construction, and bring entrepreneurial skills, establishing businesses particularly in areas like Easton and St Paul's (1 mark).
